places.description: Multi cuisine restaurant at 2075 m (6,800 ft) above sea level and possibly the highest altitude restaurant in Kerala. If coming from Top station, turn right at 19 mile. Road is bad so make sure you have a suitably robust vehicle or inform them and they will pick you up. The journey is worth it. Please inform them early if you are going there for only for food.

places.name: Parthasarathy Temple
places.description: Located within a kilometer from main temple, it's a must see temple, with its main shrine built as a chariot and Lord Krishna sitting as Parthasarathy, advocating Gita to Arjuna. The main deities are Krishna reciting Holy Gita and Arjuna hearing it.

places.name: Gokulam Estates
places.description: Vrindavanam Gokulam Estate is a 100-acre estate at Vengad in Malapuram District under the possession of Devaswom. Known as Vrindavana Gokulam Estate, it owns 550 cows, one of the largest dairy farm in Kerala. The estate also has cultivation of coconuts, cashew trees, etc., along with palm and other vegetation which provide not only cash crops but also feed for the temple elephants and cattle.

places.name: Trekking @ Karappara Road
places.description: Nelliampathy is a trekkers' paradise and you can start from Noorady junction. 3 km on the Karappara road makes you reach in Lilly village. The next village is Karady village which is another three kilometres. 'Karady' means 'bear' in Malayalam but there are no bears living here only workers of tea estates. The next two villages are Victoria and Karappara. There is a hanging bridge and tea shop in Karappara.

places.name: Vypeekotta Seminary
places.description: Located in Chendamangalam, the seminary was established by Jesuit priests from Portugal. It served as a college for training priests in the ceremonies and rituals of the Roman Catholic Church. The first printing press was established here. Today, it lies in complete ruins.

places.name: Kakkayur Kottamala Ayyappa Temple
places.description: The giant walls of this temple is at least 1½ times taller than an elephant, built of stones unbelievable in size. There are no stone quarry nearby from where this has could have been taken. These stones are laid one on top of another without any sealing in between. They have been standing like that for centuries just on gravity. Also on the walls are writings in some very old language.

places.name: Kerala Fine-Arts complex
places.description: This is one of the oldest centres, with regular cultural performances. Many require prior booking, as they are organised by prestigious societies and groups. There are some performances that have free entry, and the monthly cultural programs of Bank Employees Union is one such.

places.name: See India Foundation
places.description: Kalathil Parambil Crossroad, nr Valanjambalam Temple, Chitoor Rd. An evening Kathakali theater, where daily performances take place from 6PM-8PM. This is the oldest and first evening Kathakali theater in India. The show is preceded by a detailed discourse of Kathakali history and philosophy, elaborate make-up performances and a demonstration of Kathakali techniques.

places.name: Basilica of Our Lady of Dolours
places.alt: Our Lady of Dolours Syro-Malabar Catholic Basilica
places.description: The Roman Catholic Minor Basilica built in 1875 is locally called Puthen Palli. The long steeple is visible from anywhere in the town. The chapel has 15 altars. It boasts neo-Gothic spires and the largest interior of any church in South India with a lot of mural paintings on the walls and ceilings.

places.name: Shakthan Thampuran Palace
places.description: Named as Vadakkekara Palace, was reconstructed in Kerala-Dutch style in 1795 by Sri. Ramavarma Thampuran of the erstwhile Princely State of Cochin, well as Sakthan Thampuran(Greatest ruler of the Cochin dynasty) is preserved by Archaeological Department.

places.name: Thrissur Zoo
places.description: It is a major attraction for children and students with a variety of animals. There is a special building which houses snakes. Two beautiful niches with majestic seating are arranged for senior citizens to take rest while their children enjoy the sprawling zoo campus.
places.address: Town Hall Rd, Udaya Nagar, Chembukkav
places.price: Person above 12 years ₹20, person below 12 years & above 5 years ₹5, family ticket (father, mother & 2 children below 12 years) ₹40, still camera ₹25, handheld video camera ₹100

places.name: Vaidyaratnam Ayurveda Museum
places.description: Vaidyaratnam Ayurveda Museum is a museum showcasing the richness, the variety and the evolution of the Ayurveda traditional medicine of India. The museum was inaugurated by A. P. J. Abdul Kalam, former President of India, on 28 December 2013.
places.address: Thaikkattussery Rd, opp. Vaidyaratnam Post Office, Thaikkattussery

places.name: Kallayikkunnu
places.description: This hill station is also known as Narimadakkunnu. This is a beautiful place. Many newly married couples prefer this place for still and moving photography, while many film makers also prefer this place for song scenes. It's a place of natural beauty.

places.name: Elaveezha Poonchira
places.alt: Valley where leaves do not fall
places.description: A hill station with large hills around high. Beautiful hillocks named Mankunnu, Kudayathoormala, Thonippara and Poonchira are here. A pool here is remembered in local folklore as a bathing place used by Panchali, the legendary heroine of the Mahabharata.

places.name: Parumala
places.description: Parumala is renowned for the presence of the tomb of St. Gregorios (Parumala Thirumeni), the greatest orthodox saint of India belonging to the Malankara Orthodox Syrian Church. Parumala Thirumeni is the first declared saint of The Malankara Orthodox Syrian Church and the first Canonized Indian Saint. The church is recognized as major International Christian pilgrimage center.

places.name: Vijnana Kala Vedi Cultural Centre
places.description: Established in 1977 by a French woman, Louba Schild, under the Indo-French cultural programme, this institute is dedicated to preserving the arts of Kerala. Everything from singing to dancing to cooking to community living is taught here. Large number of foreigners, particularly French nationals camp here, for learning Schild's Mohiniyattom, in which she has specialized.

places.name: J&F
places.description: Serves authentic North Indian dishes like tandoori naan, kababs and various other Kashmiri and Punjabi dishes. This food joint is very popular among college students, and its fame, though spread through word of mouth, is fast catching up with the residents of Pathanamthitta. The serving and preparations are hygienic, although the prices are a bit exorbitant.

places.name: Kadappattur Temple
places.description: It is well known pilgrim place on the way to Sabarimala. Lord Siva is the idol here. The temple is situated on the bank of river Meenachil. In every year July 14th is celebrated as the birthday of "Kadappatturappan", beacause in that day the idol is appeared.

places.name: Madhur Temple walk
places.description: Start from Karandakkatt junction near the new bus station. Turn east on Madhur road. After Choori and Kudla you reach Ramdas nagar and Vivek nagar. There is a small junction and town called Ulliyathadakka on the way. Don't turn right, it takes you back to town. At the next junction, ignore the descending road to the left. Choose the right turn. Within a few minutes you reach Madhur temple on the riverside.

places.name: Peirce Leslie Bungalow
places.description: The only surviving bungalow built in authentic Portuguese style, it was the home and office of a famous English merchant family - the Leslies. It has been restored into a boutique hotel. The hotel management allows tourists to explore the grand exteriors and public interior spaces.

places.name: Cochin Port Maritime Heritage Museum
places.description: The museum is housed in the residence of the chief engineer during the construction of Willingdon Island. It was converted into a museum in May 2014. The museum has a rare collection of photographs depicting the evolution of the port city of Cochin.

places.name: Kerala Fine-Arts complex
places.description: This is one of the oldest centres, with regular cultural performances. Many require prior booking, as they are organised by prestigious societies and groups. There are some performances that have free entry, and the monthly cultural programs of Bank Employees Union is one such.

places.name: See India Foundation
places.description: Kalathil Parambil Crossroad, nr Valanjambalam Temple, Chitoor Rd. An evening Kathakali theater, where daily performances take place from 6PM-8PM. This is the oldest and first evening Kathakali theater in India. The show is preceded by a detailed discourse of Kathakali history and philosophy, elaborate make-up performances and a demonstration of Kathakali techniques.

places.name: Chakara Restaurant
places.description: The restaurant at Raheem Residency is the most expensive place in town but the meals are worth the price. The menu is creative and combines elements of traditional Keralan and European cuisine. Wine is available.
places.address: Alappuzha Bypass Rd, Sea View Ward, 2

places.name: Kreamkorner
places.description: This place has two locations: Mullackal Road and Cullan Road. The atmosphere and decor have an "art house" feel to it. There's a multicultural menu with tandoori choices, and the cold coffee with ice-cream beats a frappuchino any day.

places.name: Southern Beaches
places.description: Spectacular and private beaches are available at Thayyil, Kizhunna and Thottada. Adi-Kadalayi beach is a very peaceful place. Popular with European visitors. Locals are absent. Direct buses are available from State Bank area.

places.name: Hill Walk
places.description: The hills and grounds around Sri Narayana College, Thottada are an ideal place for peaceful walking because there is very little traffic and open spaces are more in this region. You can access Kizhunna beach and Ezhara beach from here. The famous Muzhappilangad drive-in beach is another 3 km from here.

places.name: City Walk One
places.description: Start from Fathima Hospital, take the narrow line opposite the hospital. Walk past Kerala NGO Union, Lakshmi Printers and Oyisca Youth Centre. Cross the culvert in the swamp, turn right, walk beyond the forest temple, Hajj House, Sunni House, again turn right to Chilli Malabar Restaurant and once again turn right to reach at the New Bus Station.

places.name: Floriculture Centre
places.description: Run by the Kerala Forest Development Corporation. A well-kept garden with a large variety of flowers and some herbal/ foliage plants, all against the backdrop of the tea plantations. Nice for taking pictures with pretty flowers.

places.name: Kaivalyam Retreat
places.description: Kaivalyam retreat has a 100% pure vegetarian restaurant which serves organic and healthy yogic food. As it is a yoga retreat more emphasis is given to food quality and hygiene. Serves North Indian, South Indian and a few continental dishes. Their desserts are good. Set in the midst of cardamom and pepper plantation.

places.name: Panchalimedu
places.description: It is considered to be the place where Pancha Pandavas lived during the exile forest life (Vanavasa Kalam in Mahabaratha epics). It is believed that Pancha Pandavas still hide there though nobody can see them, but they can see everybody. The tourist can see there are stones like furniture which are believed to be used by the Pandavas.

places.name: Guruvayur Ekadesi
places.description: This is one of the main festivals of temple, held on Ekadeshi day of month of November, where the temples are illuminated with more than 10,000 lamps. A week before the Ekadeshi, the Vilakku or Lamp festival commences, where devotees or various associations sponsor lighting of all lamps of the temple.

places.name: Pothundy Dam and Gardens
places.description: The dam garden is full of fine statues of pretty girls with floral offerings and dancing women in erotic postures. The surrounding valleys of Pothundy are even more beautiful than Nelliampathy Hills because of the expanse of green paddy fields and not-so-cold weather. Accommodation is available only at Nanmara town 5 km from Pothundy dam.

places.name: Malampuzha Gardens
places.description: Spectacular garden, suspension bridge, boating facility, Japanese garden, fantasy water theme park, toy train, acquarium and cable car. Entrance 9AM to 7:30PM. Video cameras are charged ₹1,000.

places.name: Walayar Deer Park
places.description: You can see deer and other small animals roaming about in their natural habitat. The park is in a poor condition due to lack of investment. The park spreads over 110 acres of forest area, mainly teak plantation. There are plans to convert it into a safari park, providing more amenities for the deer and other animals and also to the visitors.

places.name: Pothundy Dam
places.description: It is a reservoir built across Ayalur river as an irrigation project in 1968. It provides water to Nenmara and Ayalur villages. It is in a valley just below the Nelliyampathy Hills.

places.name: Wonderla
places.description: second largest theme park in South India. Spread over 50 acres of land with more than 50 Rides and various shows, it has well maintained gardens and five restaurants as well as small cafes

places.name: Tandoor
places.description: Tasty North Indian, particularly Punjabi, food. The Kadai chicken and ginger chicken is truly world class, and no other place in Kochi can offer their unique taste. The peas masala is also really superb. Their trademarks are romali roti and stuffed bread options. A full Kadai chicken serves at least 4-5 people. Caution, it is very spicy.

places.name: Amaara Maradu
places.description: A unique heritage hangout set in a 200-year-old Mangayil house. Serves authentic Kerala coffee and popular varieties of dosas. Regular cultural performances, cooking class, ethnic handicrafts class are some of the popular activities there. The cafe also houses a large library for reading as well as venue of regular book exhibitions.

places.name: Peechi Dam
places.description: It is a good picnic spot. Buses from Thrissur and by taxi. Boating is permitted in the reservoir and occasionally you can see wild tuskers on the forested banks, part of which forms a reserved forest.

places.name: Snehatheeram, Thalikkulam
places.description: A favorite beach picnic spot for local people with essential facilities, good restaurants and life guard on duty. This is similar in concept to Cherai beach; but a lot less crowded. This facility won a state tourism award in 2011.

places.name: Ettumanoor
places.description: Famous for having an ancient Shiva temple. Wall paintings in the temple are thousands of years old. The temple is also famous for its seven and a half golden elephants, a sequence of seven large and one small statues of elephants.

places.name: St. Mary's Church
places.alt: Known as Cheria Palli (the Little Church)
places.description: Belonging to the Malankara Orthodox Church was built in 1579 by the Raja of Thekkumkur for his Christian subjects. The interior murals, painted using vegetable dyes, depict Biblical themes.

places.name: Malayalapuzha Devi Temple
places.description: Malayalapuzha houses the one of the largest Devi (Goddess Durga) Temple and the goddess here is believed to grant boons to devotees and help them realise dreams. The temple has beautiful wall paintings and artistic stone carvings. This temple is famous for the ten day long Padayani performances held in connection with the annual festival in April/ May.

places.name: Kalloppara St. Mary's Church
places.description: St.Mary's church at Kalloppara stands in close proximity to the Bhagavathi temple within one complex as an example of the communal harmony of the place. There are two pre-Christian era granite slabs inside the church with some inscriptions in ancient Pali language. There are several Hindu-Christian wall-paintings all over the place.

places.name: Manjinikkara Syrian Orthodox Church
places.description: Mar Ignatitus Elias 111, the holy Patriarch of Anthioch of Damascus, while on his state visit to India, died at this place in 1932. His mortal remains are kept in the church at Manjinikkara. Pilgrims from other parts of India and foreigners, visit this place frequently. The Church celebrates a festival in February every year which is attended by thousands.

places.name: Konni Elephant Sanctuary
places.description: Konni is the gateway to the forest bordering the district. It is here wild elephants caught from the forests were brought here and put in wooden cages known as Anakoodu to be tamed and trained for work. It is situated 11 km away from Pathanamthitta. An elephant training college and elephant research center operates here.

places.name: Kaviyoor Rock Temple
places.description: The only surviving ancient cave temples in Kerala, built in ancient Tamil Pallava style, which is more of cultural interest than religious purpose. The temple is dedicated to Monkey God- Hanuman, hence today one can see hordes of monkeys dominating the temple and its surroundings. A regular feast for monkeys is a rare interesting sight for outsiders.

places.name: Shrine of St. Mary
places.description: You would not miss this tall granite shrine with its massive statue of Jesus Christ at the top, reminding you of the one in Rio de Janeiro (ignore the size difference!). If you happen to visit Palai in the first week of December, you should not miss the most important festival of Palai, which is the feast of St. Mary at this shrine.

places.name: Village teashops
places.description: There are two village tea shops in Parassinikkadavu bus terminus. Even though the seating arrangements are basic, the food is very clean, tasty and cheap. In Kerala, smaller restaurants of the villages offer good value for money. You can see people in big cars visiting these humble restaurants because the city restaurants offer a stereotype fare.

places.name: VOC Gate
places.description: The only remains of the office of the Dutch East India Company is this large wooden gate with a monogram VOC (Vereenigde Oostindische Compagnie), the emblem of Dutch East India Company.

places.name: Wonderla
places.description: second largest theme park in South India. Spread over 50 acres of land with more than 50 Rides and various shows, it has well maintained gardens and five restaurants as well as small cafes

places.name: Tandoor
places.description: Tasty North Indian, particularly Punjabi, food. The Kadai chicken and ginger chicken is truly world class, and no other place in Kochi can offer their unique taste. The peas masala is also really superb. Their trademarks are romali roti and stuffed bread options. A full Kadai chicken serves at least 4-5 people. Caution, it is very spicy.

places.name: Amaara Maradu
places.description: A unique heritage hangout set in a 200-year-old Mangayil house. Serves authentic Kerala coffee and popular varieties of dosas. Regular cultural performances, cooking class, ethnic handicrafts class are some of the popular activities there. The cafe also houses a large library for reading as well as venue of regular book exhibitions.

places.name: Casa Bianca
places.description: A pizzeria and restaurant at Vazhuthacaud owned and run by a lovely expatriate. Serves great, fresh tasting pastas, pizzas and all things Italian in a casual intimate setting. Definitely worth the trip from Kovalam if you're missing a good quality thin crust pizza.

places.name: Karumadikkuttan
places.description: This is a 9th century black granite statue of the Buddha, locally known as Karumadi Kuttan. This statue is protected by the Archeological survey of India.

places.name: St. Mary's Church
places.description: Alleppey has a high percentage of Christians. St. Mary’s Church (Champakulam) is believed to be one of the seven churches established by St. Thomas.

places.name: Cafe Paradiso
places.description: Nice location with shady benches directly at the northern side of the main canal (about where the boat parking zone ends). They offer real coffee (not instant), juices, lassi and snacks. Iced coffee with explicitly safe ice is also available.

places.name: Indian Coffee House
places.description: There are two main Indian Coffee Houses in Alleppey: one in the centre and one at Alleppey beach. They have the same menu (the same as the rest of Kerala in fact) and serve cheap, tasty south Indian food, ice cream and, of course, their signature coffee.

places.name: Science Park
places.description: The science park is a small facility containing displays of scientific and technological topics meant for school students.

places.name: Azhikkal beach
places.description: 2-km long footpath into the sea, fishing village. Beautiful garden and beach at Chalil village. Spectacular beach at Meenkunnu.

places.name: Drive in Beach, Muzhappilangad
places.description: 4-km-long beach with strong sand, the longest drive-in-beach in India. The village has about 24,000 people (2011). Another beach is available at Edakkad.

places.name: Thali Temple
places.description: Beautiful 14th-century temple and a second temple near a very big pond and vegetable market. The temple walls are elephant-shaped.

places.name: Climbing a hill @ Govindapuram
places.description: Take a bus to Govindapuram from Mananchira pond. Walk up the hill to Central School. Very good view of the entire city and Arabian Sea. The views are terrific but nobody comes here other than the school people. Elderly people can also reach here by hiring an auto rikshaw from Mankav junction.

places.name: Chithirapuram
places.description: Chithirapuram has old playgrounds and courts, bungalows and sleepy little cottages which all give this place an old world charm. This town is also famous for its tea plantations.

places.name: Mahaveer Veg Restaurant
places.description: Provides authentic North-Indian food with style ranging from Gujarati to Punjabi and delicious rotis. Meals start from ₹105/-. Only vegetarian food served. The downside to the place is cleanliness at the tables. Mahaveer has a branch near Purohit restaurant; this one is larger and cleaner.

places.name: Mount
places.description: Velvet lawns and the cool pleasant non-polluted continuous breeze make the sojourn on the mount a memorable experience to the tourist. From its top one can enjoy the green beauty of the Periyar Tiger Reserve with the lake on the one side and vast tea plantations on the other side.

places.name: Wagamon
places.description: The cool mountain air, mist, grass-covered hills, velvet lawns etc amek Wagamon a perfect holiday resort. The chain of three hills Thangal Hills (Muslim name) Murugan Hills (Hindu name) and Kurisumala (Christian name) is a mark of religious harmony.

places.name: Chembai Sangeetholsavam
places.description: The highlight of Guruvayur Ekadashi day is this Carnatic music festival that brings together musicians from across South India. It runs a week up to the Ekadashi day, on which all participant musicians recite the 'Pancaratna Kīrtanaṇgal̥' together: five Telugu compositions of Tyāgarāja Swāmikal̥.

places.name: Melpathur Auditorium
places.description: Outside the temple, this is a regular venue for various cultural performance. People irrespective of caste, religion etc can attend and watch the regular performances at the hall. Mostly there are classical dances, music recitals as well as recitals of Bhagavatam (sacred Krishna scriptures).

places.name: Indian Coffee House
places.description: Part of Kerala's famed coffee house chain, this restaurant offers good meals, thalis, veg biriyanis and dosas at very cheap rates, though the restaurant is not well-maintained.

places.name: Niveda Pure Veg Restaurant
places.description: Nivedya, the food offered to deity Krishna as part of worship ritual, no tasting during preparation or eating before offering are strictly practised.
places.address: Melpathur Road, Inner Circle, South Nada, Guruvayur

places.name: Silent Valley National Park
places.description: 80 km. 'Evergreen forest' with many rare species. Advance reservation by telephone is needed. Please contact: Phone: +91-4924-222056, +91 4924 253225, +91 8589 895652

places.name: St. Antony's Shrine
places.description: At this shrine that belongs to Archdiocese of Verapoly people of different faith and culture flock together day and night seeking blessings.

places.name: Gurdwara Sri Guru Singh Sabha
places.description: It is the lone Sikh Gurudwara of Kerala, established by the Punjabi community of Kochi in 1955. Special rites and Guru ka Langar rituals are held every Saturday and Sunday.

places.name: The Grand Pavilion
places.description: Popular especially during evenings for its seafood, particularly karimeen pollichathu (smoked pearlspot fish) and Alleppey fish curry.
places.address: Grand Hotel, Jewel Junction, MG Rd

places.name: Ojeen
places.description: Variety of snacks from the Malabar region, juices and milkshakes. Ojeen is probably the only place in Kochi for the delectable, meat-rich Malabar snacks.
places.address: By-lane after SBT towards Broadway, Marine Dr

places.name: Hon. East India Company
places.description: A historical themed restaurant operating within the four star Travancore Palace Hotel. Famous for its classic paintings and heritage photo galleries as well as its food. The evening buffet is one of the largest in town, offering the best of English, Kerala and North Indian cuisine.
places.address: Hotel Travancore Palace, Warriam Rd, Durbar Hall Rd

places.name: Lokah World Cuisines
places.description: Offers nine international cuisines from an American Wild West theme to Vietnamese sea-food, Italian pastas and Arabic grills. This restaurant has a family hall, a smoking lounge, a street food area and French cafe along with bakery. Free wifi for guests.

places.name: Somewhere Else
places.description: It has a cafe and restaurant. The cafe serves a wide range of coffees and mocktails, whereas the restaurant has sizzlers, steaks, grilled wraps, burgers and desserts. Also offers some good biriyanis and Indianised European options. Free wifi for guests.

places.name: Silca Bar
places.description: A lovely, upscale bar lounge popular with businessmen and upscale visitors. Famous for its signature dishes and cocktails.
places.address: Hotel Mercy, Ravipuram area, MG Rd

places.name: Appan Thampuran Smarakam
places.description: Established in 1976 at Ayyanthole where Sri. Ramavarma Appanthampuran who lived the Kumarapuram Palace. This is also a cultural museum.

places.name: Calcutta Bar & Restaurant
places.description: An old lodge converted bar, it is today one of the best bars in Thrissur, The food is very good and priced reasonably for bar standards. You have options such as rooftop, air-conditioned, or a room would be made available for more personal conversations.

places.name: Kumarakom
places.description: The place is famous for its bird sanctuary, house boats, backwaters, canals and the bungalow of Henry Baker (now run as part of a resort managed by the Taj group of hotels).

places.name: Kakki reservoir
places.description: Kakki reservoir, set in sylvan background, is an upcoming tourist destination. The splendid artificial lake offers an exhilarating boating experience. The surrounding forest abounds in tigers, elephants, deer and monkeys, offering a wonderful insight into the wildlife of the area.

places.name: Muloor Smarakom
places.description: Muloor S.Padmanabha Panicker (1869-1931) who was a famous Malayalam poet and an important social reformer of the century was born at Elavumthitta 12 km away from Pathanamthitta. His home at Elavumthitta is preserved as a monument by the Department of Culture, with several original manuscripts.

places.name: Dolphin's Point
places.description: 15 minutes from the town centre is a place called Dolphin's Point, where one can see dolphins playing in the sea of an early morning. But you have to walk from main road terminus around 2 km. Stone laid down into sea around 2 km long. You can call it a stone pier.

places.name: Malik Dheenar
places.description: Famous Dargah, madrassa, women's college, seaside pond, cafeteria, garden and ancient mosque with exquisite wooden carvings and chandeliers.

places.name: Lake Temple
places.description: The only lake temple in Kerala. There is a non-harm crocodile named "Babia". The lake temple is in a photogenic rocky place.

places.name: Holy Rosary Church
places.description: Oldest Catholic Church of Kerala dating back to the 16th century. The church features classic Gothic style. The church is famous for stained glass works brought from London.

places.name: Karapuzha Dam
places.description: Relatively small dam, but located at a very scenic site. Mostly unknown and thus unspoilt by a horde of tourists, it is a perfect way to spend a quiet evening during sunset time.

places.name: Trekking to Chembra Peak
places.description: Start from the Juma Masjidh junction and go down the Chembra peak road. The entire route is very scenic and you will reach Chembra peak within three kilometres. Going by vehicle is not comfortable as the roads are not in good condition. You will need a four wheel drive jeep.

places.name: Konni Elephant Cage
places.description: Konni is the gateway to the forest bordering the district. In the past, wild elephants caught from the forests were brought here and put in wooden cages known as Anakoodu to be tamed and trained for work. It is situated 11 km away from Pathanamthitta.

places.name: Kashi Art Gallery
places.description: is both an art gallery and a cafe that serves light breakfasts and lunches. The gallery exhibits work by popular contemporary Indian artists.
places.address: Burgar St, Fort Nagar, Fort Kochi

places.name: Shala
places.description: Started by the same people who run the Kashi Art Cafe, Shala serves delicious Keralan food. The menu which changes daily. The owner, Anoop, hires local housewives to cook their local specialties. The restaurant is in a beautiful and tastefully restored historical building.

places.name: St. Antony's Shrine
places.description: At this shrine that belongs to Archdiocese of Verapoly people of different faith and culture flock together day and night seeking blessings.

places.name: Gurdwara Sri Guru Singh Sabha
places.description: It is the lone Sikh Gurudwara of Kerala, established by the Punjabi community of Kochi in 1955. Special rites and Guru ka Langar rituals are held every Saturday and Sunday.

places.name: The Grand Pavilion
places.description: Popular especially during evenings for its seafood, particularly karimeen pollichathu (smoked pearlspot fish) and Alleppey fish curry.
places.address: Grand Hotel, Jewel Junction, MG Rd

places.name: Ojeen
places.description: Variety of snacks from the Malabar region, juices and milkshakes. Ojeen is probably the only place in Kochi for the delectable, meat-rich Malabar snacks.
places.address: By-lane after SBT towards Broadway, Marine Dr

places.name: Hon. East India Company
places.description: A historical themed restaurant operating within the four star Travancore Palace Hotel. Famous for its classic paintings and heritage photo galleries as well as its food. The evening buffet is one of the largest in town, offering the best of English, Kerala and North Indian cuisine.
places.address: Hotel Travancore Palace, Warriam Rd, Durbar Hall Rd

places.name: Lokah World Cuisines
places.description: Offers nine international cuisines from an American Wild West theme to Vietnamese sea-food, Italian pastas and Arabic grills. This restaurant has a family hall, a smoking lounge, a street food area and French cafe along with bakery. Free wifi for guests.

places.name: Somewhere Else
places.description: It has a cafe and restaurant. The cafe serves a wide range of coffees and mocktails, whereas the restaurant has sizzlers, steaks, grilled wraps, burgers and desserts. Also offers some good biriyanis and Indianised European options. Free wifi for guests.

places.name: Silca Bar
places.description: A lovely, upscale bar lounge popular with businessmen and upscale visitors. Famous for its signature dishes and cocktails.
places.address: Hotel Mercy, Ravipuram area, MG Rd

places.name: Ponmudi
places.description: A hill station nestled within a tropical forest. It offers hiking and trekking opportunities.

places.name: Chacha Nehru Children's Museum
places.description: A good children's museum with a large collection of dolls, masks, and paintings. A mini aquarium and water play area is set here. Located in Thycuad, in the heart of city, it is a good evening spot for families.

places.name: HH Uthradam Thirunal Marthanda Varma Chithralayam
places.description: Has an exhibition of portrais and pictures of memorable scenes from the life of the last Maharaja of Travancore.

places.name: Maveli Cafe
places.description: A branch of Indian Coffee House near the KSRTC bus stand in a unique spiral tower. There are other branches of Indian Coffee House in the city which also serve cheap traditional food.

places.name: Zam Zam
places.description: Near the MLA hostel, famous for Arabian dishes. Order Shawarma (shredded chicken), Shawaiya (Chicken roast), Al Faham (Chicken Roast) and Kubuz (special Arabian roti). This is a must-visit for chicken-lovers.

places.name: Sindhoor
places.description: Near the Cotton Hill Girls High School, Vazhuthacaud. Serves Chinese and Indian cuisine. The interior is designed to mimic a cave and results in a dark environment. Not very cosy or stylish. Tasty food, and good value for money.

places.name: Jain Derasar
places.description: This temple is very calm and quiet temple. Allepey has a very small Jain population.

places.name: International Meditation Society of Wayanad
places.description: A small Buddhist Theravada Hall for Buddhist prayers and Meditation along with lectures about Buddhist Philosophy. Ideal for Buddhist tourists to have a meditation and Yoga sessions here.

places.name: Kalpetta Walk. 1
places.description: Start from Zodiac Hotel, head north, pass civil station and reach SKM highschool. Return through the bypass, Goodalayi road and go upto Meppadi road. Come back by Janamaithri Park side. (4 km)

places.name: Kalpetta Walk. 2
places.description: Start from Kalpetta Bus Station, head south towards on Calicut road, turn left at Jana Maithree Park toward Meppadi. Walk in the scenic road for three km and come back in the same route.

places.name: Myladippara Trekking Centre
places.description: Myladippara is a cliff to the east of Civil Station, adjacent to the new NH bypass road. Trek to the Myladippara offers a charming experience. Beware of inconspicuously hidden leeches along the way.

places.name: Uchayoon Cafe
places.description: Look for the cafe on the left side on Bathery Road. Mr. Vinodh and his familyl is running this cafe for 60 years. Only hot food is served. Vadukappuli Pickle is available. Uses onlyl home made spice powders.

places.name: Mohyidheen Juma Masjid, Ayikara
places.description: A 300 year old mosque built under the patronage of Arakkal Royal Dynasty

places.name: Birdwatching
places.description: At Munderi Bird Sanctuary, near Varam. Many exotic birds can be spotted at Madayippara near Pashayangadi, 24 km.

places.name: Regional Science Centre and Planetarium, Calicut
places.description: Regular shows are available only in the forenoons when busloads of schoolchildren arrive from adjoining towns.

places.name: Shiva Temple
places.description: This ancient and beautiful Siva temple has an apsidal garbhagriha, decorated with typical Chola pillars and pilasters, panjaras and vyalimukhas. The central shrine has escaped any repair or change and is relatively well preserved.

places.name: Night Thattukada
places.description: There is some street-food in the evening cooked right in front of your eyes.

places.name: Garlic Routes
places.description: This place is on Kannur Road, near to Fourth Railway gate. Chicken mandhi, roasted chicken, stuffed spinach cheddar grilled chicken, masala grilled prawns are some of the dishes you should try.

places.name: Pothamedu View Point
places.description: A small village 1 km away from headworks dam. Coffee and Cardamom plantation are sights to behold.

places.name: Trekking in Mannavanchola Forest
places.description: Organized by Forest Checkpost at Perumala, two kilometers from Kanthalloor town (56 km from Munnar via Marayur). This forest is 7.5 km² in area and protects many tigers, leopards, elephants and bison.
places.price: Fee ₹.300 for Indians and ₹.650 for foreigners

places.name: Chellarkovil
places.description: This sleepy little village slops to the famous grapes, coconut, cotton and vegetable growing areas of Tamil Nadu. Abundant scenic beauty and a silver cascade add to the charm of the place.

places.name: Pullumadu
places.description: The rolling hills, velvet lawns and rare flora and fauna cascading the Holy Shrine of Lord Ayyappa at Sabarimala and the Makara Jyothi illuminations are the main attractions of this place.

places.name: Spring Valley Mountain
places.description: From the top of this hillock, you can have a panoramic view of the lush green woods of Periyar Tiger Reserve, the beautiful Periyar Lake, surrounding Kumily township and of course adjoining Tamil Nadu borders.

places.name: Palaaram
places.description: A team of foodies serves traditional home cooking to dine in or take away.

places.name: Mangalam Dam
places.description: Mangalam Dam is a dam built across the river Cherukunnapuzha in Palakkad district of Kerala, India

places.name: Tippu's Fort
places.description: Tipu's Fort which is also known as Palakkad Fort is in the heart of town.

places.name: Durbar Hall Ground
places.description: The venue for many fairs during festivals and regular evening concerts and other programmes.

places.name: Silverstorm Water Park
places.description: A good family theme park with 29 water and dry rides, a very large park and a Chinese village

places.name: BTH Kempa
places.description: A classic hotel which dates back at least 100 years. Its restaurant, Kempa, is popular among high-end vegetarian travellers. Serves North Indian, South Indian and Kannadiga-Udupi dishes.
places.address: BTH Hotel, BTH Junction, Durbar Hall Rd

places.name: Ayela & Keshai
places.description: A very good seafood restaurant with four theme courts, Kochi, Thai, Vietnamese and Japanese. It has a fresh seafood selection court, with the fish cooked in front of the guests. A multi-cuisine restaurant also operates at the site.

places.name: Itty's Place
places.description: Itty's place is an eco-friendly restaurant made completely with bamboo, coir and wood having 3 sit-down options. Favourite Italy offers traditional Italian pizzas, pastas and subs.

places.name: Archeological & Art Museum
places.description: It has the best collection of wood carvings, metal sculptures and ancient jewelers of the Cochin dynasty.
places.address: Kollengode Palace, Chembukavu, Co Operative Rd, Chembukkav

places.name: Valiyalukkal Temple
places.description: Beautiful Bhagavathy Temple in a photogenic sprawling sylvan compound.

places.name: Punnathur Kotta Elephant Sanctuary
places.description: It is unique in being the largest elephant park in the world with over 60 elephants.

places.name: Chavakad Beach
places.description: A seashore of rare scenic beauty. Acknowledged as one of the best beaches along the west coast.

places.name: Manarcaud
places.description: St. Mary's Shrine here attracts people of all faiths. Various kinds of offerings are made here devotees.

places.name: Pathiramanal Island
places.description: This is a small white sand island. It gets its name from the brilliant reflection of moonlight from the sand.

places.name: Vembanad Lake
places.description: 83.72 km length and 14.48 km width. Cruise boats, house boats and traditional cargo boats.

places.name: Wagamon
places.description: Enchanting hill station at an elevation of 1100 m, with tea gardens and meadows.

places.name: Niranam
places.description: Niranam church, is the first church to be established by St. Thomas when he landed in Kerala. It is one of the most important non-Catholic Christian pilgrimage center and seat of Kerala Orthodox Church.

places.name: Drive into the sea
places.description: Board your vehicle into the Jankar and cross the Chaliyar river to the village of Chaliyam. You can drive one km into the sea on Chaliyar pulimoott road. Too many vehicles are there, except if you come early in the morning.

places.name: Nellikunnu Uppappa Mosque
places.description: Cute structure with attached Madhrassa and Dargah. Spacious lawn and majestic steps. Famous for Uroos festival.

places.name: Nellikkunnu Beach
places.description: Light House, Shri Kurumba Temple with nice sculptures, Five km long beach road.

places.name: Indian Coffee House
places.description: The sounds and smells of Kasaragod Market can be enjoyed when you sit near the window. Very crowded place.

places.name: Pallam Charumuru
places.description: For custom-made crispy snacks and drinks like Muttacharumuru, EggPizza, etc.

places.name: Village walk
places.description: Bakkalam is an ideal village for a leisurely stroll. There are coconut plantations and paddy fields wherever you look. Walk on the Morazha road until you reach Vellikkeel bridge which is an extremely scenic place.

places.name: Kanthanpara Waterfalls
places.description: This is beautiful waterfall near the forest and a nice place for relaxing. Sept-Jan is the best time to visit.

places.name: Vijnana Kala Vedi
places.description: A school of traditional art founded by French artist Louba Schild. It imparts training in the traditional arts like Kathakali, classical dances, classical music, as well as Kalaripayattu.

places.name: Greenix Tourist Theater
places.description: A good cultural theatre with a gallery, food court and mini museum.

places.name: Sree Krishna Cafe
places.description: Gujarati restaurant famous for its cutlets and battoora, and vegetarian curries.

places.name: Fort House Restaurant and Hotel
places.description: At the waterfront, offering good Kerala food and great views.

places.name: Durbar Hall Ground
places.description: The venue for many fairs during festivals and regular evening concerts and other programmes.

places.name: Silverstorm Water Park
places.description: A good family theme park with 29 water and dry rides, a very large park and a Chinese village

places.description: Itty's place is an eco-friendly restaurant made completely with bamboo, coir and wood having 3 sit-down options. Favourite Italy offers traditional Italian pizzas, pastas and subs.

places.name: Dakhni Deg
places.description: Serves Hydrabad delicacies including Dum biryani, Tandoori stuff and great desserts. It has three branches in the city. Technopark and Kuravakonam. A must try.

places.name: Marry Brown Restaurant
places.description: A Malaysia based fast food chain serving fried chicken, burgers, seafood, finger foods, desserts and beverages. It's at Panavila Jn near the fly-over.

places.name: Dhanya Restaurant
places.description: For tapioca, Choora fish, Appam, Puttu, chicken, beef and egg biriyani, available after 12:30PM. Rice porridge is available after 5:30PM for ₹40.

places.name: Premier Bakery
places.description: Established in the year 1962, serves all type of baked food. Well known for our home made fruit salad with ice cream, variety coconut cookies.

places.name: Ramada hotel
places.description: High quality food, Indian and continental options, in an elegant ambiance. Service is optimal. Price is slightly higher than in other places, but remains reasonable.

places.name: Aqua valley water & ice cubes
places.description: Water purification and ice cubes.

places.name: Learn Horseriding
places.description: The Veteriniary University at Pookode teaches horseriding to the public. Fee ₹5,000. Course duration 24 days (one hour every day).

places.name: Cheengeri Hills
places.description: Local bus services are available for transportation between Ambalavayal and Cheengeri. Kaduvakuzhi view point is very scenic.

places.name: Valapattanam
places.description: Riverside village.

places.name: Island Walk
places.description: All coconut and areca nut. Beautiful bridge wide enough for a small car. Two more islands called AKG Island and Polthuruthy are nearby.

places.name: Rajayoga Meditation @ Brahmakumaris
places.description: Meditation centre. Free Sattvic food, meditation practice and lecture sessions. Beautifully furnished meditation hall upstairs.

places.name: Trekking @ Pythalmala
places.description: Naduvil village. 1,450 m above sea level. Limited facilities are available on the mountain track. Look for leeches and wild elephants.

places.name: Art Gallery
places.description: Near Town Hall.

places.name: Gotheshwaram Beach Temple
places.description: You can also visit nearby beach villages like Chakkum Kadavu, Kayyadi Thodu, Payyanakkal, Kayyadithode, Naduvattom, West Mahi, Thampi Road, andJhansi Village

places.name: Kizhakke Murikkunnu Bhagavathy Temple
places.description: The temple is on a beautiful hillock near an upmarket residential area, a pristine pond, green lawns and the scenic hilltop school.

places.name: Park Walk
places.description: Well maintained and manicured garden around a clean pond. Very big lawn to relax. Open only after 2PM. Extremely crowded place.

places.name: Ali Bhai Thattukada
places.description: Kadukka nirachathu, pidikozhi nirachathu, bharani chicken, fried ice cream are some of the main dishes you can try from this place.

places.name: Pure South Vegetarian
places.description: For Masala Dosai, a fermented crepe made from rice batter, black lentils, potato and onions. ₹40. They also give Kerala-style vegetarian lunch for ₹130.

places.name: Cafe Coffee Day
places.description: Upmarket place for coffee, pastry and snacks. Relaxed atmosphere. Popular hangout of foreign tourists. ₹59 for coffee and Punjabi samosa.

places.name: Thekkeppuram Food King
places.description: Pazham Nirachathu, Irachi Pathiri, Meenunda or Chicken Mammos and Unnakkaya- some of the special preparations of this restaurant.

places.name: Atukkad Waterfalls
places.description: A scenic waterfall amidst hills and jungles.

places.name: Lakkam Water Falls
places.description: (24 km from Munnar). A small waterfall.

places.name: Bicycle
places.description: Experience the natural beauty of Munnar by riding a bicycle through beautiful paths of Munnar and pass through a tea state called Madupatty, around 14 km from Munnar.

places.name: Yoga @Kaivalyam Retreat
places.description: Holistic health retreat in midst of the tea valleys of Munnar. Open year round, they teach a holistic lifestyle with traditional form of yoga and organic dining.

places.name: Grampi
places.description: Grampi is also known as Parunthupara. Because of the panoramic view from its high peaks, rocky plains and hillside it has become a tourist centre.

places.name: Mangala Devi Temple
places.description: People are allowed to visit only once in a year during chitra pournami (a Hindu festival) and is 15 km inside the forest.

places.name: Plantations
places.description: Tea, coffee, cardamom, pepper, vanilla growing areas. A walk through the spice plantations of these areas can be a memorable experience.

places.name: Vandanmedu
places.description: Vandanmedu is one of the world's largest cardamom auction centers. An excursion through the widespread cardamom plantations at Vandanmedu is an intoxicating experience.

places.name: Plantation Tours
places.description: Nr Thekkady & Kumily, a lot of spice plantations are present. Typically they will charge around ₹50 to ₹100 for showing you around the plantation and explain it to you.

places.name: Thiru Venkatachalapathy Temple
places.description: A small temple, dedicated to Thirupathi Venkatachalapathy, established by Telugu pilgrims as their token to devotion to Lord Krishna.

places.name: Annapurna Brahmin's Hotel
places.description: A well maintained family restaurant serving typical Tamil and Kerala veg cuisines. Has some of the best coffees in the town.

places.name: Kaustubham
places.description: A premier restaurant that serves almost all Indian veg cuisines, it is an upscale restaurant with well maintained interiors and premium facilities.
places.address: South Nada, opposite Sree Valsam Rest House

places.name: Mangalya
places.description: The restaurant is owned by state-run KTDC and offers good Kerala veg cuisine, mainly set meals. The restaurant is inside KTDC Shopping complex inside the Main Pandal.
places.address: East Nada, KTDC Shopping complex, inside Main Pandal

places.name: Surabi Restaurant
places.description: Part of Hotel Elite, this restaurant, offers almost all South and North Indian cuisines. The restaurant is posh and well maintained.

places.name: Woodlands Restaurant
places.description: A well maintained family restaurant serving South India, North India and Chinese vegetarian foods. Special dish: Masala Dosa.

places.name: Ranimedu Estate
places.description: Beautiful view point.

places.name: Holy Cross Church Chendamangalam
places.description: Established in 1577

places.name: Cholanoor Peacock Sanctuary
places.description: The first peafowl sanctuary in Kerala.

places.name: Jain temple
places.description: 15th century Jain Temple

places.name: Sholayar Forest
places.description: Coffee and Tea estates.

places.name: Ayalur Temple
places.description: Chariot festival during winter

places.name: Kalpathy Rathotsavam
places.description: Colourful Temple car festival where all the streets of the village will be lightened and the procession of Rathas will take place.
places.hours: Celebrated during mid of November every year

places.name: Subhash Bose Park
places.description: One of the largest parks in Kochi.

places.name: Indraprastha Gujarati Food Court
places.description: Famous for its unlimited North Indian thalis and various sweets. A full plate thali with five dishes, Roti and rice costs ₹50.

places.name: Ila
places.description: Tasty Travancore food, with both Southern Travancore veg options and Central Travancore Syrian Christian non veg specialities.

places.name: Sreekrishna Inn
places.description: This restaurant is famous for its classic look and theme, and offers a large range of Indian vegetarian dishes. The dosas are most famous, along with its elaborate thalis.

places.name: South Star
places.description: Well maintained, nice interiors. Food styles from North Indian, South Indian, Chinese and Arabic and a wide range of Biriyanis.

places.name: Arctic Circle
places.description: Steak, more than 14 sizzlers, such as an American styled sizzler with Texas mashed potatoes with mushroom sauce. 20 European dishes, along with a few continental salads.

places.name: Conucopia
places.description: A cricket theme restaurant, operating inside Bat&Ball Inn, this restaurant is famous for its wide selection of Continental, Greek, Mediterranean cuisines.

places.name: 24 Carat
places.description: A popular upscale multi-cuisine restaurant, themed around weddings, it is ideal for candle-light romantic dinners and high power lunches.

places.name: Central Park Bar
places.description: A posh, well-maintained bar having a designer lounge.

places.name: Glow&Corktales
places.description: Atlantis Junction-MG Rd. Dance floor and large lounge bar. It has night parties from Thursday to Sunday with various themes and age groups.

places.name: Oberoi Bar Beer and Wine
places.description: A good small bar dominated by men.
places.address: MG Rd, Padma Junction, North Kaloor, Kacheripady

places.name: Opium the Club
places.description: Palarivattom Jn., A posh upscale dance floor and large discotheque, it has various events from Tuesday to Sunday, each in various themes. (Closed on dry days)

places.name: Velocity
places.description: A stylish bar with a wide range of liquors and beer.

places.name: Cafe Persia
places.description: A unique Arabic themed cafe, famous for Sheeshas/Hookah smoking and an excellent range of Arabic coffee and tea, along with snacks.

places.name: Teapot
places.description: A unique cafe which serves a variety of teas, particularly 6 unique Indian flavours. It also has good traditional English snacks.

places.name: Kerala Kalamandalam
places.description: It is in Cheruthuruthy and was founded by the Poet Sri. Vallathol Narayana Menon, to encourage the study of the ancient arts of Kerala such as Kathakali and Mohiniyattom.

places.name: Ming Palace
places.description: Chinese restaurant with international and Indian cuisine.

places.name: Ashoka Bakes
places.description: Juices, shakes.

places.name: Erumely
places.description: Important pilgrimage centre for Hindus and Muslims.

places.name: Annual Food Festival
places.description: Kottayam also has an annual food and flower show. These events are quite popular and are worth a visit, if you are in town when it happens.

places.name: Boat Races
places.description: Lots of boat races with traditional boats of different sizes - around 50 types - in the months of July, August and September during Onam.

places.name: St Ignatius Orthodox MahaEdavaka Kaipattoor
places.description: This church was built at the end of the 19th century. It has been declared as 'Maha Idavaka'. The church has a Raasa every year in the month of December.

places.name: Ann's Bake House
places.description: A good place for short eats. The cakes and pastries that you get there are tasty and cheaper than what you pay for in the larger cities.

places.name: Vaikom Mahadeva Temple
places.description: Famous for Prathal (mid-day food offering by individual to others) and also Annathanam (served by the temple). Having this full fleged meal is very sacred too.

places.name: Udayanapuram
places.description: Village backwater cruise, Visit different villages and village activities, ayurvedic treatment centre, Home stay with traditional Kerala food, night fishing etc.

places.name: Beypore Harbour
places.description: If you love Malabar cost marine life, you should visit here during early mornings. You can see the busy life of fishermen. Also wide variety of fishes.

places.name: Walk into the Sea
places.description: The Beypore Pulimoott is a 1-km walkway into the sea. The walk is beautifully tiled and insufficiently lighted. Extremely crowded except in the early morning.

places.name: Maipady Palace
places.description: Palaces of Kumbala Rajas. Admission is strictly restricted.

places.name: Trekking @ Sullia Road
places.description: Beautiful views of the valley in lush green surroundings. Another added attraction is that this road is undiscovered by tourists. So you will get it all for yourself.

places.name: Village Tour
places.description: Take a bus from Kumbla to Badiadukka. Many scenic villages on the way. You can get down at Seethamgoly village in the middle of the route and have a look at the scenic place.

places.name: Viceroy Restaurant
places.description: Non Veg Restauranr

places.name: Udupi Garden Cafe
places.description: Vadapavu, Pavubaji, Masala Parotta and other vegetarian dishes. Air conditioned private dining room available. Good parking facility.

places.name: Kunhali Marakkar Memorial
places.description: This memorial was erected by the Indian Navy to commemorate the resistance of the Kunhali Marakkars to foreign invasion of Malabar in the 16th century.

places.name: Vellikkeel Eco Park
places.description: You can go across the Vellikkeel Bridge by hiring an auto-rickshaw from Bakkalam to Pattuvam (₹200). Very beautiful mangrove swamps and an estuary.

places.name: Vismaya Water Theme Park
places.description: Parking facility for 100 cars, several rides, shops selling swimming clothes etc. This business venture is owned and managed by the local Communist Party.

places.name: Temple Dining Hall
places.description: Free food is given to all visitors. They offer tea with fried mung beans for breakfast. Lunch is traditional Kerala style vegetarian thali on a plantain leaf.

places.name: Qassim Bakery And Fast Food
places.description: Famous for its biryanis more than anything.

places.name: Vagamon
places.description: A nice place to visit, with pine trees to explore!

places.name: boat safari
places.description: Better chances of animals you will get in morning with the boat ride from thekkady. ₹500 is entry fee to the reservation and ₹225 is for the 1.5h boat ride on periyar lake. (2023)

places.description: A dense pine forest covering, classified as a buffer zone by the Kerala state forestry department, with an estimated 30 species of birds, including rare endangered species.

dishes.name: Appam
dishes.description: An appam or aappam is a type of thin pancake in South Indian cuisine. It is made with fermented rice batter and coconut milk, traditionally cooked in an appachatti, a deep pan similar in shape to a wok. It is a popular dish in the Indian state of Kerala as well as Sri Lanka.

dishes.name: Upma
dishes.description: Upma, uppumavu, uppindi, kharabath, upit, upeet, rulanv, uppuma, or uppittu is a dish of thick porridge from dry-roasted semolina or coarse rice flour. Upma originated from Southern India, and is most common in Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, Kerala, Maharashtra, Odisha, Tamil Nadu and Telangana. Various seasonings and vegetables may be added during cooking.

dishes.name: Puttu
dishes.description: Puttu or Pittu is a dish native to the South Indian states of Kerala and Tamil Nadu. It is also native to Sri Lanka in the regions of Jaffna, Trincomalee, Batticaloa,Ampara and Negombo, Puttalam. It is a famous breakfast dish among Sri Lankan Tamils.

dishes.name: South Indian parotta
dishes.description: Parotta is a layered Indian flatbread made from maida (refined flour) and oil. It is soft, flakey, and layered. It is commonly seen in Sri Lanka and in South India, especially in the states of Kerala and Tamil Nadu.

dishes.name: Matta rice
dishes.description: Matta rice (also known as Palakkadan/Kerala/Rose Matta rice, Kaje Rice in Karnataka, or Kuththarisi) (Malayalam: കേരള മട്ട, Tulu:കജെ അരി, Odia: ମୁଗେଇ ଚାଉଳ (Mugei Chaula), Kannada: ಕಜೆ, ಕುಚಲಕ್ಕಿ, Tamil: குத்தரிசி, lit. 'Kuttarici') is an indigenous variety of rice grown in Udupi and Dakshina Kannada districts of Karnataka, Palakkad district of Kerala,a traditional red parboiled rice variety from the Mayurbhanj and Balasore districts of Odisha, India and in Jaffna district of Northern Province, Sri Lanka. It is known for its coarseness and health benefits. It is popular in Kerala and coastal Karnataka in India and Sri Lanka where it is used on a regular basis for idlies, appams and plain rice.

dishes.name: Sadya
dishes.description: Sadya, also spelt sadhya, is a meal originating from the southern state of Kerala in India. It is of cultural importance to the Malayalis, consisting of a variety of traditional vegetarian dishes and side-dishes usually served on a banana leaf as lunch. Sadya is typically served as a traditional feast for the festivals of Onam and Vishu, as well as other special occasions such as birthdays and weddings.

dishes.name: Achappam
dishes.description: An achappam (achh meaning mould in Malayalam, and appam meaning food made with flour) or achu murukku (murukku meaning a crunchy snack in Tamil) is a lightly sweetened, deep fried rose cookie made with rice flour, coconut milk, sugar and egg, predominantly found in Kerala and other parts of South India. It is a signature Kerala snack believed to have originated from Dutch influence. It has since spread to South East Asia, where it has various local names such as kuih loyang (brass), acuan (mould), cap (stamp), bunga ros (rose flower), bunga durian (durian flower), goyang (shake), kembang loyang, dok jok (water lettuce), etc.

dishes.name: Avial
dishes.description: Avial or aviyal is an Indian dish originating from southern India. It is a thick stew of usually 13 vegetables commonly found in the Western Ghats and coconut, seasoned with coconut oil and curry leaves. Avial is considered an essential part of the main meal in Kerala (oonu in Malayalam) and Tamil Nadu, often the star dish in a traditional Kerala Sadhya and is also served as a delicacy in South India.

dishes.name: Kanji
dishes.description: Kānji is a rice water based dish traditionally prepared in Indian states including Orissa, Andhra Pradesh, Tamil Nadu and Kerala. Depending on how it is prepared, it is eaten with soup or curry. It is one of the Chappan Bhog (56 food items also known as Mahaprasad) offered to the Hindu god Jagannath of Puri as part of the last meal of the day (known as Badaw Singhara Bhogaw).

dishes.name: Unni appam
dishes.description: Unni appam, unniyappam or karollappam is a small round snack made from rice, jaggery, banana, roasted coconut pieces, roasted sesame seeds, ghee and cardamom powder fried in oil. Variations of this organic and spongy fried batter using jackfruit preserves instead of banana are common. It is a popular snack in Kerala.

dishes.name: Ada pradhaman
dishes.description: Ada pradhaman is a traditional Keralite dessert made by using the rice ada (rice pasta or flakes) with a sauce of cooked coconut milk and jaggery. Ada pradhaman is specially prepared in homes of the state of Kerala in India on the festival day of Onam. It is a variety of payasam, and is served together with sadya.

dishes.name: Ada
dishes.description: Ada, ela ada, patholi, genasele, or yelaiyappam is an Indian sweet traditionally served in Kerala, Karnataka, Konkan, and parts of Tamil Nadu. It consists of rice parcels encased in a dough made of rice flour, with sweet fillings, steamed in a banana leaf, and served as an evening snack or as part of breakfast. It is made of raw rice flour, sugar or jaggery, and grated coconut.

dishes.name: Avil Milk
dishes.description: Aval Milk or Avil Milk is a Kerala cuisine drink sold in the streets of the Malabar region of Kerala, India. Aval milk is made with aval which is essentially poha or beaten rice flakes, along with ripe bananas, milk of any kind, and nuts.

dishes.name: Thoran
dishes.description: Thoran; or upperi in Northern Kerala is a class of dry vegetable dishes combined with coconut that originated in the Indian state of Kerala. This common dish is usually eaten with rice and curry and is also part of the traditional Keralite sadhya. In Tamil Nadu, a similar dish is known as Poriyal.

dishes.name: Pathiri
dishes.description: Pathiri is a pancake made of rice flour. It is part of the local cuisine among the Mappilas of Malabar region in Kerala State of Southern India. Pathiri is a popular dish among the Muslims in Kerala.

dishes.name: Malabar matthi curry
dishes.description: Malabar matthi curry, also known as fish curry, is a traditional Kerala dish. It is usually prepared with fish semi-stewed in a Kerala-style sauce that typically includes a blend of spices and assorted vegetables, such as okra or onions. While sardines are commonly used, the dish can be prepared with a variety of fish, such as mackerel, kingfish, or pomfret.

dishes.name: Chatti pathiri
dishes.description: Chatti pathiri is a layered pastry made in the Malabar region, of Kerala, India. It uses pastry sheets or pancakes made with flour, egg, oil and water. The filling can be sweet, made with sweetened seasoned beaten eggs, nuts and raisins, or savoury, with the traditional meat filling used in samosas or savoury puffs.

image.author: Ranjithsiji

dishes.name: Neyyappam
dishes.description: Neyyappam or Yeriyappa is a sweet rice-based fritter fried in ghee. Neyyappam has its origins in the southern Indian state of Kerala and coastal Karnataka. The name is derived from the words neyy (നെയ്യ്) meaning "ghee" (clarified butter) and appam (അപ്പം) meaning "pancake".

dishes.name: Kerala beef fry
dishes.description: Kerala beef fry is a dish made of beef, slow-roasted in a mixture of spices, onions, curry leaves, and coconut slivers, fried in coconut oil. The dish is also popularly known in Kerala as Beef Ularthiyathu.

dishes.name: Theeyal
dishes.description: Theeyal is a South Indian dish originating from the Indian state of Kerala. It has a soupy consistency, and is made from a mixture of spices consisting of roasted coconut, coriander seeds, dried red chili and fenugreek. All spices are ground to a paste and cooked in tamarind water with vegetables.

dishes.name: Kaalan
dishes.description: Kaalan is a Keralite dish from South India, made from yoghurt, coconut and either raw plantain (nendra kaaya) or a tuber such as elephant-foot yam (chena). It is thick and sour, and is one of the dishes of the Kerala sadya, the traditional vegetarian feast.

dishes.name: Injipuli
dishes.description: Injipuli, also known as puli inji or inji curry, is a sweet, sour and spicy Kerala condiment made principally from ginger, tamarind, green chillies and jaggery. It is one of the standard items of the Kerala sadya (banquet) and is regarded as an essential component of the feast served at Onam. Though most strongly associated with Kerala, it is also prepared in neighbouring Tamil Nadu, where it is served at weddings and other functions.

dishes.name: Pidiyum kozhiyum
dishes.description: Pidiyum Kozhiyum is a traditional food item of St. Thomas Christians in Kerala. It is a kind of dish which can be consumed for breakfast or dinner.

dishes.name: Spiced rice
dishes.description:
Spiced rice is a rice-based dish flavored with various types of spice. Spiced rice is common around the world, with one of the most notable dishes being Indian Ghee rice, which uses ghee as a primary ingredient.
Spiced rice is common among the people of Kerala, especially Malabar region of Kerala, Tulunad region of Karnataka and in Tamil Nadu.
